i1.title: Swiss Arabian Patchouli 01 Extrait de Parfum 50ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
A modern fougère: lavender and pink pepper over rich patchouli and labdanum.

Swiss Arabian Patchouli 01 Extrait de Parfum 50ml is a modern, woody patchouli. Lavender, bergamot, blackcurrant and pink pepper open, geranium, orange blossom and elemi form an aromatic heart, and it settles into patchouli, labdanum, olibanum, vanilla and tonka.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Lavender, Bergamot, Blackcurrant, Pink Pepper, Grapefruit
  • Heart: Geranium, Orange Blossom, Elemi, Lily of the Valley
  • Base: Patchouli, Labdanum, Olibanum, Vanilla, Tonka

Key details

  • Brand: Swiss Arabian
  • Concentration: Extrait de Parfum
  • Size: 50ml
  • Scent profile: Woody · Aromatic · Oriental
  • Wear: Unisex

Why you'll love it

  • A fresh lavender and pink pepper opening
  • An aromatic geranium and elemi heart
  • A deep patchouli, labdanum and olibanum base
  • Rich Extrait de Parfum concentration

FAQ

What does Patchouli 01 smell like?

Lavender, bergamot, blackcurrant, pink pepper and grapefruit first, then geranium, orange blossom, elemi and lily of the valley, finishing with patchouli, labdanum, olibanum, vanilla and tonka.

Is it unisex?

Yes, it is made for everyone.
